#  13498 - Technical English Environmenal Technology Water B2 Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **13498**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Technical English Environmenal Technology Water B2**  |  
|  Fachenglisch Umwelttechnik Wasser B2   |  
| Department:  |  ZES - Language Centre   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Riebow, Ute 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every summer semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Action-oriented tasks for global, selective and detailed listening and reading comprehension, for the production of topic and situation-related written texts, for topic and situation-related oral expression as well as exercises for comprehension and consolidation of linguistic structures (vocabulary and grammar). In addition, learning strategies and techniques for self-study are presented and practised. The main emphasis is placed on the build-up of a comprehensive set of technical vocabulary. On the basis of technical texts the participants will practise to apply different reading strategies. In addition, the participants will practise how to describe processes and procedures. They learn how to explain technical terms, give definitions and how to provide missing information. They will be able to solve problems and present the solutions in an appropriate manner.  |  
| Contents:  | Water protection (aquatic systems, food webs, lake zones, stratification)Water pollution (sources and effects, pollutants, eutrophication, mining lakes)Hydrology (flooding, groundwater hydrology, water distribution)Hydroelectric powerWater treatment (requirements, treatment processes)Wastewater treatment (facilities, processes)Grammar: countable/uncountable nouns, question formation, tenses, passive, modal verbs, linkers   |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | Modules B1.1, B1.2, B2.1 or B2.2 or English skills at level CEFR B1+ / B2  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Exercise / 4 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 90 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | Scriptadditional materials on Moodle platform  |  
| Module Examination:  | Continuous Assessment (MCA)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 4 tests of 45 minutes each (weight of each grade is 25%)  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * Abschluss im Ausland / Environmental and Resource Management / keine PO 

 |  
| Remarks:  | This module especially aims at students of the degree courses Environmental Engineering, Land Use and Water Management and exchange students with an English language competence at level CEFR B1+/B2. Students must also register at the Language Centre (https://www.b-tu.de/sprachen)! No more than 25 participants can be enrolled in each language course group. The courses can be held face-to-face or online.   |  
| Module Components:  | 019248 Exercise Technical English for Environmental Technology - Water B2  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |
